control_model.ownership: repository-owned periodic post-half-density control, not the actual source cross-null operator or physical domain

fourier_classification.complete_constant_family: every constant Hermitian two-by-two lower term has exactly one real coordinate in each of I,H,S,K
fourier_classification.periodic_invariants: the spectrum depends on c, rho^2=x^2+y^2 and z modulo integer reindexing; z and -z are isospectral by n to -n
fourier_classification.commuting_unitary: constant unitaries commuting with J rotate the (x,y) plane and preserve rho^2 while fixing c and z

candidate_subfamily.spectral_gap: gap from zero is a, attained at n=0
candidate_subfamily.candidate_order: 0<log(2)<log(3), so the two candidates have distinct exact gaps
candidate_subfamily.selector_condition: the gap distinguishes log(2) from log(3) only if an independent source/action or physical reduction owns the coefficient a, the periodic domain and this operator
candidate_subfamily.nonselection_without_owner: defining V=log(r)H inside a repository control merely restates r in spectral form

half_density_boundary.transport: a periodic positive compatible matrix density W is removed by periodic U=W^(1/2), while an independently owned W-self-adjoint lower term survives as U*V*U^(-1)
half_density_boundary.constant_scope: the Fourier formula applies when the post-transport potential is constant and the transported domain is periodic
half_density_boundary.nonperiodic_warning: a nonperiodic U twists boundary data, and a variable transported potential is not diagonalized by the constant Fourier blocks
